credits.title: Drummer Boy
credits.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

credits.title: Ranabaali
credits.overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

credits.title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
credits.overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

credits.title: Mystery Island
credits.overview: London Police psychiatrist Dr. Emilia Priestly needs to take a relaxing break from her stressful job, so her wealthy friend, Baroness Jane Alcott, invites her to Mystery Island, an immersive murder-mystery-themed resort hosting a special retreat for the original investors. credits.title: Two Puddles
credits.overview: When a family encounters two radically unusual puddles on a woodland retreat, unspoken tensions finally surface.

credits.title: Remora
credits.overview: Set in the faded, disintegrating grandeur of an English seaside town, Leighton works for a petty loan shark as a low-level enforcer, keeping an eye on and shaking down the vulnerable and poor.

credits.title: Stereotype
credits.overview: Armed with a flick knife, a teenage boy journeys into the night to vent and mourn over his brother's murder and gets locked into a moral dilemma that will change his life forever.

credits.title: Happy New Year
credits.overview: A ten-year-old boy who wants to be Jewish has a difficult day when a school test clashes with Rosh Hashanah.
